blocks.html: Talk to Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid.

options.text: If you are, then why are you still selling goods from a stall?
I'd like to help you but....
[Accept Quest]
No, I'm really too busy.

No thanks, I'm good.

blocks.html: In the house immediately to the south-west, talk to Sami the Camel Man to ask for two camels. Offer 500 coins.
blocks.text: In the house immediately to the south-west, talk to Sami the Camel Man to ask for two camels. Offer 500 coins.

What price do you want for both of them?
Would 500 gold coins for the pair of them do?

blocks.html: Use the red hot sauce on a trough in the pen west of the camel shop.
